_comment: Row-6 extension companion: NOMINAL-bias body (RREF 20.5k, no ladder starvation) at
Vctrl 1.65 V, mismatch instrument, N = 4200, seed 245, seed_scope shared -- sample k is
the same die as the extension rung request request-r6-ladder-ext245-mismatch.json, so
vte_avg here is that die's nominal I_tail (the assembler's I_nom). This is the same
pairing the original ladder used (its I_nom came from the S2 1.65 V point of the same
seed-244 draw); the extension needs its own companion because its seed is new.
engine_version 47 is the fail-closed post-run pin; the body carries selft=0.

measurements.name: t_cross_1
measurements.spice: .meas tran t_cross_1 WHEN v(vdiff)=0 RISE=1 TD=10n

measurements.name: t_cross_11
measurements.spice: .meas tran t_cross_11 WHEN v(vdiff)=0 RISE=11 TD=10n

measurements.name: vdiff_max

measurements.name: vdiff_min
measurements.spice: .meas tran vdiff_min MIN v(vdiff) FROM=10n TO=20n

measurements.name: vdiff_late_max

measurements.name: vdiff_late_min

measurements.name: isup_avg

measurements.name: vtail_avg

measurements.name: vte_avg
